alternatives: Lead with the complete feature inventory and architecture before offering a command
Describe the bootstrap dry run as a repository audit even though it only plans file creation and conflicts
decisions.choice: Lead with the immutable educational demo as the first reproducible value, then describe the bootstrap command only as a dry-run file plan.
decisions.rationale: A new maintainer can verify one bounded admission behavior quickly, while exact terminology prevents a conversion path from claiming diagnostics the product does not perform.

alternatives: Present every included adapter definition as proven end-to-end stack support
Let installation examples proceed when the referenced immutable release or evidence is absent
decisions.choice: Require an immutable release check before installation and label adapters as reference definitions that still need project-specific end-to-end validation.
decisions.rationale: Failing closed on an absent release and separating included definitions from proven integrations keeps the public promise reproducible.

alternatives: Hide the vacant reviewer seats until a contribution is ready to merge
decisions.choice: Disclose the single-maintainer bootstrap and the post-v1.0.0 independent-review gate beside the first-value path.
decisions.rationale: Contributors should know which feedback is useful now and which authoritative changes remain blocked before investing effort.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: A missing command, expected result, status boundary, or governance disclosure denies promotion.
acceptance_criteria.observable: Before the feature inventory, the README gives the immutable demo v1.0.1 command, its exact final result, the core v1.0.0 verification stop, the assurance boundary, and the reviewer-capacity boundary.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: Any unsupported audit, safety, release, adapter, or governance claim denies promotion.
acceptance_criteria.observable: The README never presents the bootstrap preview as a repository audit, an absent release as available, reference adapter definitions as proven integrations, or repository controls as Maximum Assurance.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: Any unresolved mismatch or absent independent challenge denies promotion.
acceptance_criteria.observable: An independent reviewer reproduces the demo from its immutable tag, checks every first-screen claim against source and release state, and finds no mutable, fictional, or over-broad promise.

acceptance_criteria.failure_behavior: A stale or false first-value path remains unpublished until a corrected governed change passes the same contract.
acceptance_criteria.observable: If a tag, command, output, assurance boundary, or reviewer state stops matching reality, promotion remains blocked and the last verified public instructions stay authoritative.

outcome_metrics.observable: Percentage of sampled first-value commands, outputs, release identities, limitations, and governance claims reproduced from immutable public state and reviewed source.
outcome_metrics.source: Independent prelaunch review of at least twenty exact README assertions against tagged demo output, core release state, repository source, and governance records

failure_modes.condition: The first command references a mutable or absent artifact, or its displayed result differs from execution.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: The mismatch is reported, installation remains blocked, and no substitute prose is treated as evidence.
failure_modes.rollback_trigger: Any immutable-reference, command-output, or release-state mismatch triggers removal or correction before promotion.

failure_modes.condition: Public copy expands a bootstrap preview, adapter definition, or portable control into a stronger product or assurance claim.
failure_modes.expected_behavior: The claim is narrowed to the behavior that can be reproduced and the launch remains gated.
failure_modes.rollback_trigger: Any fictional audit behavior, blanket stack support, safe-code promise, or hidden governance dependency blocks promotion.

goals: Let a new maintainer reproduce one bounded MergeGrounds behavior in about ninety seconds before reading the full architecture
Make the core release, adapter maturity, assurance boundary, and reviewer capacity explicit before installation or contribution

invariants.statement: Every command and result in the first-value path matches a real versioned executable path; bootstrap preview is never described as a repository audit.
The README distinguishes an educational demo, Portable controls, reference adapter definitions, and externally administered Maximum Assurance.

non_goals: Implementing a new repository-audit command or claiming that bootstrap performs one
Publishing v1.0.0, changing GitHub account settings, or weakening any admission or governance gate
Claiming end-to-end support for a stack without a public fixture on the current immutable release

signals.decision_use: Deny promotion when any required first-screen element is missing or appears after the feature inventory.
signals.name: README first-value contract result

signals.decision_use: Deny promotion when an immutable demo command, expected output, release status, adapter boundary, or governance claim cannot be independently reproduced.
signals.name: Independently reproduced public claims

problem: A prospective adopter currently reaches a long capability inventory before a reproducible first action, while launch copy elsewhere has confused the dry-run bootstrap file plan with a repository audit and overstated stack readiness. This creates avoidable activation friction and risks earning trust with claims the executable product does not support.

rollback.strategy: Keep the candidate unpublished and retain the last verified README until the immutable command, expected output, status, and boundary claims are corrected through the governed path.
triggers: The demo tag or final output differs from the documented first-value path
The core release is described as installable before its immutable evidence exists
An adapter, assurance, or reviewer-capacity statement exceeds independently verified state

title: Lead public adoption with reproducible first value

controls: Immutable version references and exact expected output
Executable contract tests for first-screen structure and negative claim language
Independent reproduction against public release and governance state
Fail-closed installation wording when release evidence is absent
trust_boundaries.data: Commands, expected output, release status, assurance limitations, adapter maturity, and reviewer capacity presented to prospective adopters
trust_boundaries.source: Maintainer-authored public README and repository state
trust_boundaries.target: Prospective maintainer installation and contribution decision
